story.title: TEST| Inbound 834| WI HIX ON EXC | Member Enrollment via CMS 834 - EDI

scenarios.title: CMS WI member 834 file is ingested and loaded to EDIStageArchive
CMS WI member 834 processing creates canonical on TM

flagged.why: duplicates the first case's same flow

gaps: Duplicate intent with TC_002: both validate canonical creation/correspondence for the same CMS WI inbound 834 end-to-end flow. TC_001 Description: "Verify that a CMS inbound 834 file containing WI On-Exchange member enrollment data is accepted from the inbound NAS location, processed through the ENR and TM flow, archived under the WI inbound archive folder, displayed in TM with accepted completion statuses, and results in a canonical record for the processed transaction." TC_002 Description: "Verify that the canonical generated on TM for a processed CMS WI On-Exchange inbound 834 transaction corresponds to the exact processed file instance by matching transaction traceability across TM, archive, staging records, and FACETS member data for the member carried in the file."
